title: Use AI Video on CapCut PC (Seedance 2.5) to add new characters, environments…
content:
Use AI Video on CapCut PC (Seedance 2.5) to add new characters, environments, and story turns after a shared opening scene instead of simply extending the original clip.  
Use CapCut PC’s AI Edit to iteratively refine specific moments (character details, visual elements, scene adjustments) by keeping what works and improving what doesn’t.  
Use CapCut PC’s AI Extend to generate missing narrative beats (setup before the action, consequences after the decision, final closing moment) to help reach a 3+ minute story.  
Assemble and polish the final video in CapCut PC’s multi-track timeline after generating/adjusting scenes with Seedance tools.

CapCut PC の AI Edit を使えば、うまくいっている部分は残し、そうでない部分は改善しながら、特定の瞬間（キャラクターのディテール、ビジュアル要素、シーンの調整）を反復的に洗練できます。

Seedance ツールでシーンを生成・調整した後は、CapCut PC のマルチトラックタイムラインで最終動画を組み立て、仕上げます。
